arcades.info_text: Associació A.R.C.A.D.E. (aka ARCADE.cat) is a non-profit cultural association aiming the preservation and divulgation of arcade games and culture, by a wide array of means: collaborating with cultural entities and other media such as films, podcasts, radios, etc, organizing tournaments, and restoring machines of its private collection. Our main objective is to preserve the feel and essence of old arcades, as well as modern ones. / The association is run collaboratively by its members in their free time as a labor of love, with frequent events, workshops and tournaments. Its premises is home to an extensive collaborative collection of arcade and pinball machines that cover over 40+ years of arcade history. It has a mix of dedicated cabinets (rhythm games, racing games, classic games, etc.) as well as Candy cabinets and Spanish generic cabinets from the 90s, with games usually being switched from time to time. All of them are set on Free To Play. / Keep in mind, this is not a game center open to the public. Access to the premises is for members and accompanying guests only. However, we hold many different tournaments throughout the year (A.R.C., SHMUPFEST, TBAP and more upcoming)...

arcades.info_text: La industria de los videojuegos diseñados para salones recreativos, dejó de estar presente en Europa a finales del año 2000. Los videojuegos domésticos de nueva generación, los impuestos abusivos, y la crisis hizo que las maquinas recreativas dejaran de fabricarse, y lo más grave… que estos sistemas fueran destruidos para no pagar las tasas mensuales que sus propietarios debían abonar sólo por tenerlas. / En Arcade Planet, hemos conseguido rescatar y restaurar las mejores recreativas de la historia, y preservando los mejores juegos de todos los sistemas. / Arcade Planet ofrece su increíble colección de Arcades para eventos, exposiciones, organización de torneos, y sesiones de juego libre “free play”. / Con esta iniciativa aquellos que jugaron en los 80 y 90 volverán a recordar los mejores ratos de ocio de sus vidas… y las nuevas generaciones descubrirán la especial interpretación del modo de juego creado para salones recreativos… donde el único propósito es la diversión inmediata. / (PLEASE CHECK OPENING TIMES ON EITHER FACEBOOK OR INSTAGRAM, BETWEEN 15:00 AND 17:00 THERE'S A PAUSE AND THE ARCADE CLOSES THOSE 2 HOURS). / The out of order board was the same as Litwak’s Arcade. arcades.info_text: Japan Weekend (Salón del manga) is an important otaku event that takes place in various locations of Spain. The Japan Weekend itself has its own cabs, where they usually bring them to their respective cities where the event is hosted. Sometimes other companies and associations will bring their cabinets, but this page will only include the cabs that supposedly are property of Japan Weekend and usually appears on the events. / This "arcade" is being added because this event is the only way many cities (like Valencia) can have modern rhythm games to play, at least for a weekend. Address, city and cabs will be updated depending on the event being hosted on a specific city. / Keep in mind that cabs are rotated, so some (or all) cabs may or not appear at all. This list will be based on previous events. Also cabs are placed in pallets, giving them more height. / -Next events: / [b]Madrid: 26th-27th September --> Av. de Luis Aragonés, 4, San Blas-Canillejas, 28022 Madrid[/b] / --- / Bilbao: 3rd October / Valencia: 21st-22nd November (probably at Feria Valencia) / Alicante: TBA / Barcelona: TBA

arcades.info_text: Nextage is a non-profit association in Madrid and the meeting point for the largest rhythm game communities in Spain. This is where fans of Pump It Up (PIU), ITG, DDR, Sound Voltex, and Beatmania IIDX live, with tournaments, challenges, and meetups in a close, authentic environment. We're not a business: we're a community built by and for arcade lovers. If you're looking to improve, enjoy, or simply share this hobby with people like you, this is your place. / Access to the warehouse is for members and accompanying guests. You can also appoint a visit on the open days at weekends on their website. / Entrance fee is 7€ (or 10€ for both weekend days), and you can become a member for 30€/month, which includes entry into a private group, and being able to come on weekdays / If you'd like more information on the project or would like to arrange for a visit, please contact at our social media.
